MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The original J-B Weld epoxy felt useful for small repairs alongside my fastening supplies, without assuming it could replace structural screws or nails.",
    "The outdoor duct tape fit temporary outdoor repairs, a plausible next need after my outdoor deck screws."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The thermometers and feeler gauge require specific measuring tasks that my recent purchases do not suggest.",
    "Marine epoxy, a replacement trash-can lid, and hex nuts depend on a marine repair, a compatible container, or matching bolts that I have not indicated needing.",
    "Twelve wastebaskets and twelve tubes of super glue felt excessive without a current task requiring those quantities."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations treated general repair and maintenance supplies as broadly interchangeable, even though fastening wood does not imply temperature checks or precision gap measurement.",
    "My vacuum-bag purchase seemed to be stretched into a broader need for waste containers, although replacing bags does not imply needing bins or lids."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails and wood screws point toward fastening tasks where dimensions, materials, and compatibility matter.",
    "I choose supplies for a particular job: a general repair adhesive can be useful, while marine adhesive or a large glue pack needs a more specific reason.",
    "My replacement vacuum bags fit named vacuum types, so that purchase suggests attention to an existing item's compatibility rather than a general interest in cleaning equipment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair needs but extended them too broadly to supplies that require different tasks, equipment, or quantities."
}
